help.title: Usage Guide
help.intro: MultiTapKey translates how you press the trigger key (single, double, triple, long press) into the output keys you bind. The trigger key defaults to F24 and can be changed freely; it can come from any device.
help.section.bind: Use gesture output keys in other software
help.bind.keynote: Key point: do NOT try to "record a hotkey" with your mouse/trigger key. When any software is recording, it captures the physical key pressed at that instant (e.g. F24) — not the output key MultiTapKey translates it into.
help.bind.how1: 1. In MultiTapKey, set the output of a gesture (e.g. long press) to the key you want (e.g. F5).
help.bind.how2: 2. In the target app (e.g. a screenshot tool), set its hotkey to F5 directly — press F5 on your keyboard in its recorder dialog.
help.bind.how3: 3. Now, when you long-press the trigger, MultiTapKey outputs F5 and the target app responds.
help.bind.note: Why recording does not work: the recorder captures the physical key (F24). This is a system-level behavior; MultiTapKey cannot block other apps from seeing the physical key.
help.bind.alt: If the output key is special (e.g. F13-F24) and your keyboard has no such key: some apps let you type the key code manually; otherwise this scenario cannot be set up via "recording".
help.settings.trigger: Trigger key: use the "Trigger" button in the binding editor to record a different key — it does not have to be F24.
help.settings.pause: Pause / exit: the app lives in the system tray. Closing the window asks whether to quit or minimize to tray; right-click the tray icon also exits. While paused, all gestures are disabled.
close.title: Close MultiTapKey
close.message: Closing the window keeps the app running in the tray. Do you want to quit completely or minimize to tray?
binding.min_taps: At least one tap level is required.
config.version_incompatible.title: Configuration Version Incompatible
config.version_incompatible.message: An old or unsupported configuration file was found. MultiTapKey will create a new default configuration — please reconfigure. The old configuration is not converted.
